operation: WBI header invalidation through /sys/power/image_drop (Sony's own kernel path)

action.which_is: the same sysfs entry Sony's ud_wbi_drop.elf uses

evidence_files.live-block0-4096.bin: pre-drop capture, matches both archives byte for byte
evidence_files.live-block0-after-drop-4096.bin: post-drop capture, header zeroed, neighbour intact
evidence_files.state-before-drop.txt: boot_id, uptime, image_mode, pid157 stat, dmode, updater dir, CautionConfig hash

next_step_required: PHYSICAL POWER CYCLE ONLY. Remove the battery for >=30 s. Never use fastboot reboot or any software reboot: the two past failures both used a software reboot while the WBI was invalid, which left the camera in an incomplete power transition with no USB enumeration.

recovery.precondition_after_boot: a normal boot proves a real cold start happened; the WBI is still zero
recovery.restore_gate: requires bytes 0..511 entirely zero and bytes 512..4095 to match the archive

why_this_should_give_a_cold_boot: With a zero header none of Loader2's four predicates match, so the ssboot/ss_bis rows cannot fire. The cldboot row's handler at 0xFE049A43 is preceded by 0xFE049A42 'movs r0,#0 ; bx lr', an always-zero stub, so boot mode falls through to a real cold path instead of restoring the snapshot.
